correctness.rationale: The exact weight-three reduced Swiatkowski chain has 16,192 top generators and 16,132 independent third-boundary columns modulo three. Sixty explicit integral third cycles, including 59 disjoint-simple-cycle products and a 5,034-term nonproduct cycle, have a 60x60 coordinate minor of determinant -1. This proves that they are an integral basis of the saturated top kernel. Exhaustive enumeration and exact characteristic-zero elimination show 1,040 geometric product tori span rank exactly 59. Hence H_3 is Z^60 and its quotient by products is Z. Full standalone verifier recomputed rank, all relevant boundaries and the determinant.

value.rationale: The complete primitive product-torus obstruction for a canonical symmetric cubic graph is a motivated topological invariant, not an arbitrary lattice calculation: all 1,040 geometric torus products miss precisely one integral top-homology direction. An explicit nonproduct cycle and basis clarify which homology classes are genuinely non-geometric products; the result can guide investigations of nonproduct graph-braid homology without asserting unproved generalizations.
